about: A balance scale whose beam tips by the real sums as things drop into its two pans, each as it is named: weighing up two sides, which outweighs which, evidence for and against, a trade-off, keeping both sides equal.

left.about: things in the left pan, split by |

right.about: things in the right pan, split by |

leftWeights.about: how heavy each left thing is, split by commas

rightWeights.about: how heavy each right thing is, split by commas

when.about: moments each thing drops in, left ones first then right; else when its name is said, or one after another
